description: Fahali gives AI agents eyes on market risk. 18 detection engines deliver anomaly, capital-flow, regime, dark-pool, whale, contagion, and crash-precursor intelligence across crypto and equities/ETFs. Every signal is resolved against realized price in an append-only ledger. All 22 tools are read-only — no order routing, no path to capital. Engines without enough resolved outcomes report 'calibrating' — never an invented number. Observation, not financial advice.

defaultPrompt: What is Fahali detecting right now? Show me the three highest-conviction risks, what changed, why it matters,
Where is institutional capital moving right now—and what is retail missing?
Stress-test my portfolio and tell me which position would bleed first.
